description_en: Analyze the specified text-based conversation content and extract summary-related information, such as the title, keywords, summary, and other specified details
description_zh: 分析指定的文字通话内容，提取摘要类相关信息，比如标题，关键词、小结以及其他指定的信息
kebab_example: aliyun ccc analyze-conversation --instance-id 9cfad875-6260-4a53-ab6e-b13e3fb31f7d --contact-id job-109634426711870000 --task-list-json keywords --field-list-json 'code_:_OrderNo_,_name_:_订单号_,_description_:_订单号_,_code_:_ProductName_,_name_:_商品名称_,_description_:_商品名称' --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AnalyzeConversation

parameters.help_en:
List of Task Types for analysis. Valid values include:

- title: title

- summary: summary

- keywords: keywords

- fields: fields

Currently, only "summary" and "title" can be passed together. All other parameters must be passed individually
parameters.help_zh:
分析的任务类型列表。其内容可以是：
- title：标题
- summary：小结
- keywords：关键词
- fields：字段

目前仅summary和title可同时传递，其他的参数只能单独传递
parameters.name: task_list_json

parameters.help_en: When the TaskListJson parameter is set to "fields", this parameter specifies the field content to fetch
parameters.help_zh: 当TaskListJson参数为fields, 此参数指定要提取的字段内容
